title: Resolution urging MTA to deck LIRR tracks in Flushing
summary: This resolution calls on the Metropolitan Transportation Authority to start a capital project to build a deck over parts of the Long Island Rail Road Port Washington Branch open cut between Flushing and Murray Hill, Queens. The open cut runs about 4,100 feet and covers roughly 4.35 acres, dividing the neighborhoods and causing quality-of-life problems like dumping and snow buildup. The Council wants the MTA to study decking the area to create a linear park, parking and better neighborhood connections, building on a prior Department of City Planning analysis.​
